projects.title: Automobile Price Prediction and Customer Segmentation
projects.description: Built an ensemble model using Random Forest and Gradient Boosting on 800K+ records, achieving 96% prediction accuracy to support data-driven pricing and revenue optimization. Applied K-Means and Hierarchical clustering for customer segmentation, improving targeting accuracy by 30% through feature engineering, data cleaning, and iterative model tuning. Translated model outputs into actionable pricing tiers and segment profiles, enabling stakeholders to quantify revenue impact and personalize offerings across customer cohorts.

Translated model outputs into actionable pricing tiers and segment profiles, enabling stakeholders to quantify revenue impact and personalize offerings across customer cohorts.

projects.title: Az National Trucking – Hadoop, Hive & Tableau Big Data Analytics
projects.description: Ingested 8,000+ geolocation records and a 100-driver fleet dataset into HDFS using Cloudera Hadoop (HDP), created Hive tables via DDL, and queried data through Apache Impala connected to Tableau via ODBC driver for large-scale operational analytics. Built interactive Tableau dashboards analyzing unsafe driving events across 100 drivers and multiple truck models, identifying geographic hotspots and risk scores through behavioral analysis to surface key predictors of fleet safety and fuel efficiency. Delivered data-driven recommendations for route optimization and driver coaching, translating complex geospatial and behavioral patterns into actionable fleet performance insights for operational stakeholders.
